objective.description: The app should feel instant everywhere it matters.

expected.summary: Lead with "Performance guardrail: api_latency p95 <= 20ms" (critical), then investigate before changing code. 2 test suggestions, 2 fix steps.

suggestions.title: Performance guardrail: api_latency p95 <= 20ms
suggestions.rationale: A supplied measurement already exceeds this budget.

draft.description: Given the flow in scope, when api_latency is measured externally, then it must stay within 20ms.

suggestions.title: Performance guardrail: api_latency p95 <= 3000ms on auth (login, registration)
suggestions.rationale: The caller set this budget explicitly; establish the external measurement first, then enforce it. Scope "auth (login, registration)" is exempted with a relaxed budget: Users tolerate multi-second auth flows.

draft.description: Given the flow in scope, when api_latency is measured externally, then it must stay within 3000ms.

steps.title: Profile before changing code
steps.description: Measure and locate the bottleneck first; optimization guesses usually miss.

steps.title: Optimize the located hotspot, guarded by the measurement
steps.description: Apply the smallest effective change and keep the external guardrail as the arbiter.

risks.description: Optimizations often trade readability or memory for speed; the measurement must justify the trade.

fixPolicy.rollback: Revert the optimization if the external measurement shows no improvement or a regression elsewhere.

evidence.detail: Caller requested performance: The app should feel instant everywhere it matters.
search p95 p95 on /search measured at 42ms
login p95 p95 on /login measured at 800ms
responsiveness budget: api_latency p95 <= 20ms, set by the caller.
responsiveness budget (relaxed by exemption): api_latency p95 <= 3000ms on auth (login, registration), set by the caller.
Scope "auth (login, registration)" relaxed to 3000ms (caller): Users tolerate multi-second auth flows.
search p95 on /search measured 42ms, exceeding the responsiveness budget of 20ms.
